note: Every host the Preparação reaches, in one list. The Diretor gives it to the Criadora only after a Preparação download fails because her Claude cloud workspace blocks the host (see skills/estudio/references/getting-started.md). No Hugging Face host is here on purpose: the speech model is served from this repository's own GitHub Release. The repo's tests fail when an installer URL or a vendor.json URL uses a host missing from this list, and when a Hugging Face host is added. GitHub, PyPI and uv change their redirect and download hosts over time: measure again on a real Preparação before editing.

measured.method: A real Preparação (instalar.sh ffmpeg, python, remotion, on Linux) run with HTTPS_PROXY pointing at a logging CONNECT proxy that prints every host a client opens; the Location header of a GitHub Release download read with curl -sIL; the URLs of the node and macOS ffmpeg steps requested through the same proxy.
measured.redirect: GitHub Release download: github.com answers 302 with Location: https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com/github-production-release-asset/... (captured for astral-sh/uv, the same path form as this repository's model Release, which is not published yet). martin-riedl: /redirect/latest/... answers with a redirect to /download/macos/arm64/<build>/ffmpeg.zip on the same host.

hosts.usedFor: The speech model (this repository's GitHub Release), ffmpeg on Linux and Windows (BtbN builds) and uv.
